label: Small hospital
lead: You have an ICU. You have wards. You have a pharmacy with Schedule-X drugs, an OT, an HR head, and a Medical Director who signs everything. The software you bought for the clinic next door breaks at 30 beds.
why: Bed map. Admission → discharge → summary, all one record. Pharmacy + lab + OPD billing roll up to the IPD bill.
Surgery slot reserves OT staff, consumables, post-op room. Cancellations release the chain.
The metrics NABH wants — ALOS, infection rate, medication errors — surface without 4 admins building Excel models.
30 staff. Statutory PF / ESI / TDS auto-computed. Doctor incentive structures by department.
